title: Academic Calendar - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Academic Calendar - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The academic calendar provides a comprehensive schedule of the institution’s academic year, detailing the start and end dates of the fall and spring semesters, midterm and final examination periods, and key holidays. It also highlights special events, notably the 93rd Founder's Day, which is observed with a ceremony and alumni gathering. The calendar serves as a reference for students, faculty, and staff to plan coursework, breaks, and institutional activities throughout the year. It ensures alignment with national holidays and institutional traditions, fostering a structured academic environment. The page offers a clear, organized overview of all critical dates and events.
key_points: The fall semester starts in early September and ends in mid‑December.
The spring semester begins in early January and concludes in early May.
Midterm examinations are held in late October and mid‑March.
Final examinations take place in early December and late April.
The 93rd Founder's Day is celebrated on November 12 with a ceremony and alumni gathering.
The academic calendar includes holidays such as Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s break.
